tldr.text: HDFC Bank reported quarterly PAT of Rs 19.5 billion, representing ~12.7% year-on-year growth excluding trading gains.
tldr.evidence: quarterly PAT of R s 19.5 billion, which is a growth of 12.7% approximately if you exclude the trading gains.

tldr.text: Total AUM grew 15.3% YoY, driven by strong growth in SME and retail assets.
tldr.evidence: Total AUM grew 15.3% year - on - year, including a 1.9% impact of FCNR (B) leverage, with SME and retail assets leading the charge.

tldr.text: Deposits grew 18.8% YoY on a reported basis, supported by a 4 percentage point lift from the special FCNR (B) window.
tldr.evidence: Deposits increased 18.8% year - on - year on a reported basis, including a 4 percentage point lift from special FCNR (B) window.

tldr.text: Asset quality remained strong with GNPA at 1.11% (down 13 bps YoY) and credit costs low at 44 bps.
tldr.evidence: Our asset quality remains pristine, with GNPA at 1.11%, 13 basis points lower than year - on - year. Credit costs remain low at 44 basis points

tldr.text: Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha requested early retirement by end of December, alongside ongoing MD & CEO transition to Anup Bagchi.
tldr.evidence: Kaizad, has requested for a n early retirement by end of December.

management_commentary.text: Retail disbursements crossed Rs 90,000 crores in Q2 FY27, accelerating from Rs 76,000 crores in Q1 FY27.
management_commentary.evidence: The pace of retail disbursements is accelerating and has cro ssed R s 90,000 crores during Q2 FY 27 as against R s 76 ,000 crores in Q1 of this year.

management_commentary.text: The bank added ~1.7 million liability relationships in Q2 FY27, up 25% compared to Q1.
management_commentary.evidence: We added about 1.7 million liability relationships in the second quarter, which is 25% higher than Q1

management_commentary.text: Process automation and digital adoption reduced product turnaround times by 10% to 15% and service delivery TATs by 30%.
management_commentary.evidence: The turnaround times on product deliveries have come down anyway between 10 % and 15% in a short span of time, while service delivery TATs have come down by 30% during the quarter.

management_commentary.text: HDFC Bank led the banking sector under the ECLGS 5.0 scheme with disbursals of Rs 41,000 crores.
management_commentary.evidence: Our ECLGS disbursals of R s 41,000 c rores were highest across all banks as of August 26, when the scheme achieved targeted levels.

guidance.text: Net interest margins are expected to begin an upward trajectory starting from Q3 onwards.
guidance.evidence: The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.

guidance.text: Rate adjustments on the 70% floating rate loan book will offset FCNR deposit cost headwinds, keeping margin impact neutral to positive.
guidance.evidence: Net of that, we still think that th ere can be neutral to positive on the margin as we go forward.

guidance.text: Management intends to maintain the LCR target range between 110% and 120%, with ~115% as the midpoint target.
guidance.evidence: Yes, we would like to operate between 110 and 120, which we have told you over last few years, somewhere probably in the middle, 115.

segment_performance.notes: Disbursements exceeded Rs 90,000 crores in Q2 FY27. Annual growth in retail assets ex-agriculture reached 11.2% in September 2026.
segment_performance.evidence: retail assets ex agri, September'26 annual growth is about 11.2% compared to 9.1% as of June'26 and 7.4% as of March'26.

segment_performance.notes: EOP loan growth accelerated to 23.5% YoY in September 2026, with business banking component up 28% YoY.
segment_performance.evidence: September'26 EOP loan growth has grown 23.5 % year - on - year compared to 17% to 18% year - on - year growth levels seen in the last few quarters.

segment_performance.notes: Corporate bank book expanded 2.8% QoQ and 16.4% YoY.
segment_performance.evidence: corporate bank has grown 2.8% in this quarter. Year - on - year, it is about 16.4%

segment_performance.notes: New card issuances reached 1.4 million in Q2 FY27, up nearly 19% QoQ.
segment_performance.evidence: New credit card issuances at 1.4 million have grown by nearly 19% quarter - on - quarter, indicating the expansion of the growth runway.

segment_performance.notes: Book growth remained in single digits, and gross NPA ratio on agriculture remained stable between June and September.
segment_performance.evidence: As of September, compared to June, our gross NPA on agri has remained largely constant. We've not seen any signs of concern or deterioration.

key_metrics.evidence: GNPA at 1.11%, 13 basis points lower than year - on - year.
Credit costs remain low at 44 basis points, the risk weights to total assets at 69%.
The bank's well - balanced performance translated to ROA of 1.8%, which has been the range that we've been th ere for a very long time

notable_qa.question: Why did margins decline to 3.32% and what drove the sequential cost of funds trend?
notable_qa.answer: Cost of funds remained flat QoQ at 4.4%. High volume of time deposits (1.3 trillion of 1.57 trillion deposit growth) weighted on cost mix, but retail asset repricing and segment mix will aid margins going forward.
notable_qa.evidence: firstly, with respect to margins, again, margins are down to 3.32. ... One is, coming on the interest expense side, you'll see that our cost of funds is flat quarter - to - quarter, at about 4.4% last quarter to this quarter.

notable_qa.question: How are FCNR funds deployed and how will margins move in the coming quarters?
notable_qa.answer: FCNR funds are fully deployed into assets for ANBC and PSL compliance; floating rate loans (~70%) will benefit from rate hikes by December, driving an upward margin trajectory from Q3.
notable_qa.evidence: how are you deploying the FCNR funds? ... The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.

notable_qa.question: Will LCR at 113% constrain loan growth, and what is the potential impact of proposed bancassurance commission rules?
notable_qa.answer: LCR will be managed within the target band of 110-120%. While draft insurance commission rate cuts present a high initial impact, persistency gains, volume growth, and cost structure adjustments will serve as mitigating levers.
notable_qa.evidence: Will this become a constraint on your incremental loan growth going ahead if the deposit mobilization remains relatively weak? ... Yes, we would like to operate between 110 and 120

risks.text: Proposed regulatory draft cuts on bancassurance commission rates pose potential top-line impact unless offset by volume and cost efficiencies.
risks.evidence: in its current form, when you look at only the commission, it is pretty strong, p retty high impact.

risks.text: LCR metric pressure resulting from non-retail deposit reliance used to cover large one-off non-retail deposit outflows.
risks.evidence: one - off outflows, which is not within our control, some planned, some unplanned as well , w hich necessitated the institution to take resort to some of the non - retail deposits which have a lesser LCR cover

risks.text: PSL compliance shortfalls in small and marginal farmer categories due to high market scarcity and elevated procurement costs.
risks.evidence: The small and marginal farmer, to the extent it's available, we are there to take, either originate organically in our book or buy it in the market. It's very scarce.
